settle_quiet_ms.semantics: after observing a newer completely stored packet revision, build its full projection and retain it only when the same exact revision remains unchanged for this interval

optional_server_timing.semantics: non-authoritative handler diagnostics outside data; excluded from state snapshots and decision fingerprints

stability.semantics: present only when the returned full projection was built from the exact revision that remained unchanged for the requested quiet interval

atomicity.quiet_revision_check: the projected source sequence is rechecked under the CivCom state-projection lock after the quiet wait
atomicity.projection_construction: each candidate full projection is built while holding the same state-projection lock and rebuilt after any changed packet revision

stability.decision_sample_policy: an exact packet revision observed before and after the quiet interval and projected under the packet lock is equivalent to two identical deterministic projections
stability.fallback_policy: when the source does not advance, cannot remain quiet, or advances before locked projection construction, return an ordinary unmarked full response and let the client continue v4 stability sampling

invariants: settle_quiet_ms is valid only for a sufficient bounded pln_authoritative source wait
an unmarked state_response never counts as a proxy-settled sample
the client accepts the marker only when its policy, source sequence, and minimum interval exactly satisfy the current stability request
legacy and v4 state queries preserve their response semantics
